info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Retrieve Reward Details API
info.description: The Retrieve Reward Details API allows users to obtain specific information about a reward by its unique identifier. This API is crucial for consumers such as banking customers and support teams who need to review reward offerings, eligibility, and usage within the banking loyalty program. By accessing reward details, users can make informed decisions regarding participation and engagement in the rewards program. This API facilitates transparency and enhances the customer experience through insightful and detailed reward information.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific reward.
get.description: Fetch comprehensive information about the reward identified by the given ID. This endpoint allows users to obtain all relevant details, including reward attributes and any associated metadata.
